payout_quote: Payment of $30/hour, $70 for a full fMRI session. Payment of $15/hour for behavioral session.
steps: Open the Vanderbilt Tong Lab fMRI information sheet (official lab site)

Confirm eligibility: 18+, no glasses requirement (contacts OK), no severe astigmatism, not pregnant/breastfeeding, no history of neurological disorders, no nervous-system medication, no metal in body, no claustrophobia
Sign up via the lab's SONA link (linked in the info sheet)
Complete the behavioral session first (paid $15/hour); based on performance, qualify for the fMRI session
Complete the fMRI session (up to 2.5 hours including ~30 min setup): visual tasks in the 7-Tesla scanner
Receive $30/hour ($70 for a full fMRI session) per session
catches: You must first complete the behavioral session and qualify on performance to reach the fMRI session
Payment differs: $15/hour behavioral vs $30/hour fMRI ($70 full session)
Strict MRI safety screening (metal, pregnancy, claustrophobia, medications, neurological history)
biggest_catch: The fMRI session (higher pay) requires passing the behavioral session first; MRI safety screening excludes metal/pregnancy/claustrophobia.
eligibility: 18+; contacts OK (no glasses to read); no severe astigmatism; not pregnant or breastfeeding; no history of neurological disorders; no nervous-system medication; no metal in body; no claustrophobia.
timing: Each fMRI session up to 2.5 hours including ~30 min setup; payment per session completed.
